enum class OpenMode :
uint8_t {...};
kAtTheBeginning= 1 << 0
Sets the seek pointer to the beginning of the file
when the file is opened.
Values:
kAtTheEnd= 1 << 1
Sets the seek pointer to the end of the file when the
file is opened.
▽ △
kTruncate= 1 << 2
Removes existing content when the file is opened.
kAppend= 1 << 3
Append to the end. Always seeks to the end of the
file before writing.
kText= 1 << 4
Opens the file as text. The encoding is specified
during design time for the whole file storage by
PersistencyFileProxyInterface.encoding.
kBinary= 1 << 5
Opens the file as binary. If not set, the file will be
opened as configured by PersistencyFileProxy
Interface.category or, if that is not configured, as
text.
Header file:
#include "ara/per/basic_operations.h"
Description:
This enumeration defines how a file shall be opened. The values can be combined (using &
and |) as long as they do not contradict each other.
